full_name: International Symposium on Space Sailing (International Symposium on Solar Sailing until 2019)
organizer: International Committee for space/solar sailing (members from TU Delft, Univ. of Glasgow, FH Aachen, DLR, NASA, NYC College of Technology, Polytechnic Univ. of Bari, etc.), with a rotating host institution
fields: solar sails, drag sails, electric and magnetic sails
mission concepts (sunshades, solar reflectors, debris removal)
flight demonstrations (ACS3, Solar Cruiser, CubeSat sails)

submission.type: Abstract submission for oral or poster presentation; full papers optional (not required to present)
submission.typical_final_deadline: Around or shortly after the symposium (optional paper)
submission.notes: 2025: abstract deadline 14 Feb 2025, notification 28 Feb 2025, optional paper deadline 18 Jul 2025. 2023: abstract submission open 21 Nov 2022 to 15 Mar 2023, papers due 5 Apr 2023.

next_edition.notes: No 8th ISSS host, dates or call had been found as of 2026-10-16. Intervals between editions have ranged from 2 to 4 years, so the year is not inferred.

editions.notes: 4th International Symposium on Solar Sailing (ISSS 2017). Dates also in NTRS: https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20170001488

editions.venue: FH Aachen University of Applied Sciences
editions.notes: 5th International Symposium on Solar Sailing (ISSS 2019). Dates also in https://eprints.gla.ac.uk/191892; a COMPASS news post (https://www.compass.polimi.it/news/compass-at-5th-isss-2019/) reportedly says '30th June', apparently a typo.

editions.venue: New York City College of Technology (City Tech), CUNY, Brooklyn
editions.notes: 6th International Symposium on Space Sailing; the first under the 'Space Sailing' name. Cross-checked 2026-10-16: abstract_deadline changed 2023-03-15 -> 2023-04-02; the official ISSS 2023 timeline page lists April 2nd, 2023 as the abstract submission deadline (the Second Announcement PDF had March 15).

editions.venue: Echo building, Delft University of Technology
editions.notes: 7th International Symposium on Space Sailing, chaired by Jeannette Heiligers (TU Delft). Cross-checked 2026-10-16: abstract_deadline 2025-02-14 confirmed on the official key-dates list; the 2nd Announcement PDF (and the page's ESA-sponsorship text) give 7 February 2025, the earlier date.

notes: The series was the 'International Symposium on Solar Sailing' (Herrsching 2007, New York 2010, Glasgow 2013, Kyoto 2017, Aachen 2019) and was renamed the 'International Symposium on Space Sailing' from 2023 to cover drag, electric, magnetic and beamed-energy sails. No edition was held in 2014-2016, 2018 or 2020-2022. Abstract deadlines for 2017 and 2019 were not found. There is no permanent website, so official_url points to the latest edition. The 2025 programme has a dedicated 'Sailcraft Design and Deployment' session plus 'Sail Materials' (membranes, deployable solar arrays) and an origami deployable reflector talk.

verification.crosscheck: independent blind re-research of 2022+ editions, conflicts adjudicated 2026-10-16
